tweets.text: 🇮🇶 Something serious may be brewing in northern Iraq. For decades, the Kurdish region has been dominated by the Barzani family and their ruling Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP). Now, KDP armed forces are surrounding the homes of members of the powerful Herki tribe in Erbil province. This isn't just a police operation. The Herki are one of the largest and most influential tribes in the region, and deadly clashes between them and the KDP last year exposed rare cracks in the Barzanis' grip on power. Source: Naya / Writer: Ian Video Video
